Hadith.2295 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) circumambulated the Kaaba, and when he reached the Yemeni Corner, He (sw) raised his head toward the Kaaba and said:
"All praise is due to Allah (swt), who has honored and magnified you.

All praise is due to Allah (swt), who sent me as a prophet and made Ali an imam. O Allah (swt), guide for him the best of Your creation and keep him away from the worst of Your creation."
[Chapter=CHAPTER 64 - CHAPTER ON THE ORIGIN OF THE KAABA, ITS VIRTUE, AND THE VIRTUE OF THE HARAM (SACRED SANCTUARY)]
بَابُ ابْتِدَاءِ الْكَعْبَةِ وَفَضْلِهَا وَفَضْلِ الْحَرَمِ
